name: Rite of the Bold
desc: Go to the Children of Echoes and search for clues concerning the Volcanic Token.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Unlock Requirements</color>
Allow 2 in-game days to pass after talking to Manqu and completing the following Quest Series:

customize.name: Shadows of the Mountains
customize.desc: A World Quest series following Titu, a storyteller, to investigate the Shadow Pins.

customize.name: Tale of Dreams Plucked From Fire
customize.desc: A World Quest series following Chikya, a woman of the Night-Wind Clan, to search for the "panacea."

customize.name: Between Pledge and Forgettance
customize.desc: A World Quest Series following Little One, a little Tepetlisaurus that received "Blessing," to cure it.

customize.name: Lost in the Woods
customize.desc: After having just arrived in Natlan, you are teleported to a strange space...

customize.name: Rite of the Bold
customize.desc: Go to the Children of Echoes and search for clues concerning the Volcanic Token.

customize.name: Revelations from the Past
customize.desc: You have obtained permission to make a pilgrimage to the volcano from Pacal. Set out with Little One after you finish your preparations.

customize.name: Adventure EXP
customize.desc: Adventure EXP. Used to improve Adventure Rank.

customize.name: Primogem
customize.desc: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Achievements</color>
The Legend of the Legendary Heroes

Go near the <color=#ece5d8>Stadium of the Sacred Flame</color>
Go to the <color=#ece5d8>Children of Echoes</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Talk to</color>

customize.name: Manqu
customize.desc: A researcher for the Saurian Relics Association, who is responsible for scholarly inquiries into certain tribal customs. The real Manqu was a craftsman who lived a thousand years ago and died during the overthrow of the tyrant Och-Kan. Now, Manqu is a phlogiston projection of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan.

customize.name: Little One
customize.desc: A little Tepetlisaurus that received theBlessing. It accompanied the Traveler on a pilgrimage to the Great Volcano of Tollan to remove the mark.

customize.name: Manqu
customize.desc: A researcher for the Saurian Relics Association, who is responsible for scholarly inquiries into certain tribal customs. The real Manqu was a craftsman who lived a thousand years ago and died during the overthrow of the tyrant Och-Kan. Now, Manqu is a phlogiston projection of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan.

customize.name: Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan
customize.desc: The talisman of the Sage of the Stolen Flame. It is said that the sage who once stole phlogiston from a dragon's claws left this behind as proof of a pact made with the tribes.

customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Stadium of the Sacred Flame, Natlan</color>
Quest Objective: Go near the Stadium of the Sacred Flame
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>There seems to be some secret hidden within Traveler's body. Head to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame and ask around about Traveler.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm... We've been traveling in Natlan for some time now, but we haven't turned up a single clue about the token we need for the volcano.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Shall we head over to the Children of Echoes and see if that oddball Manqu's made any progress?
<color=#ece5d8>"Children of Echoes", Natlan</color>
Quest Objective: Go to the Children of Echoes
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>Go to the Children of Echoes and search for clues concerning the Volcanic Token.</color>
Quest Objective: Talk to Manqu
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> ...Is there any room to negotiate?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Manqu, look at me. Didn't you hear what Titu said? No one's attempted this feat in almost 500 years.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Even if you claim that you've found a possible entrance...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Well, so what? You listen well — no human or Saurian companion setting out on this road has ever returned. Not a single one.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Um, forgive my directness, but...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Well, there's our Relics Association guy. And that over there... Is that the chief of the tribe?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! Relics Guy!
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Ah, it's you, Traveler... Paimon, and Little One.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Huh, a Tepetlisaur with a red tail scarf! Mighty energetic, and looks different right off the bat too! Alright, little fella, give us another!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Raaawr!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Not bad! So you're Little One? And I suppose that makes you two the ones it chose...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> And haven't you two been the talk of the town lately, Traveler, Paimon? Manqu here's been mumbling about you constantly, and Titu mentioned you after his return.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> It wouldn't be a stretch to call your recent deeds "legendary," and you've been a friend to us Children of Echoes thus far.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> There's no need to thank me too much.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Haha, quite the phenomenal youngster!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> And it is in that capacity, Manqu, that I'm telling you — it is not our way to push guests into a fiery pit just to prove a hypothesis.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> That's not how "I'd" treat my guests, anyway.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> sigh ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What's all this about, anyway? Something about danger, and a fiery pit?
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Apologies. Allow me to explain...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Remember what we spoke of before? To remove the mark of the Flamelord's Blessing, you need to bring the two required token types to the volcano.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> One of the tokens is in the ruins beyond the Children of Echoes' land...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> There are conditions for getting in, though.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Based on past custom... Which I only just found on a woven scroll, by the way, since it's been ages since anyone's hankered to try this.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> If you wish to take your Saurian companion to the volcano and perform a baptism to cleanse the Flamelord's Blessing, you must be recognized by said Saurian's corresponding tribal chief...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> With Little One being a Tepetlisaurus, this means the chief of the Children of Echoes.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Isn't that you?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Well, yeah, though I'll be real, I don't know if this rule applies to outsiders. Still, Traveler...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> For hundreds of years, many are those who have tried to free their Saurian companions from what runs in their bloodline... this thing that is more curse than blessing.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> But not a single one has succeeded... Which is why the tribes gradually abandoned the custom...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> A zero percent success rate, seriously!?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Yes, so perilous is the journey. It's also said that the trial that must be passed before one may obtain the token will test not only the warrior who steps forth, but also the Saurian with them...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> You are not of the tribes, but I will not have you die in vain.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> So please, Traveler, I suggest that you leave Little One here with us.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> If nothing else, I can ensure it will be taken care of until the day it must enter the Night Kingdom.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But... If we do that...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> ...As I said, Little One will be unable to grow up.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Roar...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Looks like that's not what it wants.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> I'll try this all the same.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Despite the immense peril?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Yes.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> And what about you, little fella?
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Hahaha! Unyielding, resolute, yet passionate. Your hearts blaze like fine phlogiston.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Alright then. Then I shall award you the right to embark on the volcanic pilgrimage.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Alright! Let's go get that first token, then!
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> No, not yet. Now that you are qualified, you must undertake a trial of witnesses...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Ancient custom dictates that the warrior and Saurian must together obtain the feather of a green quetzal deep in the woods, and offer up a stole of animal pelts...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> And together, you must win fifty battles for our tribe, and offer up ninety-six gems of high quality...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Uh, I wouldn't be eligible to...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Can you give me a discount on those for Mora?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Oh come now, Manqu, forget it. Where are those traditions even from? Some lost stone age?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> The purpose of those formalities was to foster the bond between human and Saurian, and hone their skills — and I've had it with all that.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Anyway, as I see it, neither Traveler nor Little One seems to need that sort of proof.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> To put things simply, Traveler, we have here in Natlan a super simple way of dealing with such situations...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Fight me, and prove your strength!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Right on!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wait? Here? Oh, do you mean we're going on stage?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Of course not, haha, the stage isn't a place for tunneling... Our duel grounds are in the mountain to the rear.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Come, let's head there — we'll have ourselves a good one!
Quest Objective: Go to the duel arena
Quest Objective: Challenge Pacal
(Fight Pacal)
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Let the battle commence! Go get 'em, Uchu!
<color=#ffffff>Uchu:</color> Raargh!
(Defeat Uchu)
<color=#ffffff>Uchu:</color> Roar...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Uchu, see why I'm always telling you to eat less... Haha, I haven't been this pumped for ages!
(Challenge Pacal again if the fight was failed)
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Again, forgive my directness... But while I am aware of your strength, be careful all the same.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> He obtained no Ancient Name, but Pacal is not to be taken lightly... so long as he's kept his training up these last few years.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> If you're ready, then we can begin.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: We're ready!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> In that case, on your marks. The duel will soon begin.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Need to prep for a bit.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Of course. I'll tell him once you're ready...
Quest Objective: Defeat Pacal
Quest Objective: Talk to Manqu
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe, nice! We won! Great job us!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Hah... Hoo. I'm not sure even the best warrior in our tribe could take you out... That was a sound defeat indeed.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Whaddya think, huh, buddy? Looks like we need more training!
<color=#ffffff>Uchu:</color> Mmmm...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Quite a spectacular battle, indeed...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Pretty words, Manqu, but is that all you've got? Wanna try your hand too?
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> No, thank you very much.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Bleh. Boring. Ah, that was a great match! Traveler... You're the real deal.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I was just warming up, you know...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Hahaha! Cocky, too! Still, I admire that. The strong should also assert their dominance a bit! I mean, what's the point of getting strong otherwise?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: You weren't bad either.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Hahaha, save the commiseration. Now, if I was younger, who knows how that might have gone? Ah, how I wish I could have taken you on then.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Haha, looks like you really are well taken care of, Little One...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Of course! Little One's our trusty buddy, y'know!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> I am very glad to hear that.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> As promised, this is proof of your accomplishment from a tribal chief.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> As for its official name — well, Manqu, there's your cue...
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> The Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan... the Sage of the Stolen Flame.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Yeah, I can never memorize that name, but I do remember that after the Pyro Dragon Sovereign's death, and after the first Pyro Archon was revived from the flames...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> The Sage and the Archon each brought back one token from the volcano, and whomsoever obtains both may enter the cleansing fire within the volcano and purge all curses and calamities.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Still, how long did this Sage live anyway, Manqu? I feel like there are tales of him from the tribal era to that of Ochkanatlan...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> ...And even around the Shadow Pin.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Well, he was the first human to use phlogiston... and who knows what fate came upon such legendary figures?
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Some say both his body and spirit turned into phlogiston, becoming one with Natlan's winds, lands, and flowers, granting him the power to hear the prayers for help directed at him by all the tribes.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> Some say that each era boasted its own successor to the sagely title, passing it on even to this day.
<color=#ffffff>Manqu:</color> But — and excuse my bluntness — these are mostly storytellers' speculations.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Haha, watch yourself with those words. You'll make Titu mad again.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Alright. My duties are hereby discharged— oh, wait, tradition does demand one more thing...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Which is to grant the brave journeying soul and their companions my blessing.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Hmm?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ooh, so that's also a ritual you all do, huh?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Heh, it's just moral support. Don't get your hopes up, eh?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Right, then. Traveler, Little One...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Here I am, chief.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> May you soar through the mountains like the hardiest bird; May the wicked tides break upon you as if you were the hardest of stones.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> May you fear no hardship, for the world is bound to be full of it. May you never forget each other, for fate must bring an inevitable farewell.
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> May you reach your destination and gain what you desire... And most of all, I hope that you shall safely return.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> I will.
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Eh? Wait, does Paimon get any blessings?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Haha! As for you, little Paimon... May you eat and drink well, sleep sumptuously, and see goodly growth!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: That sounds pretty good to me!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Can you even grow, goodly or otherwise, Paimon?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Of course! Just you wait, Paimon's gonna be as big as three mountains before you know it!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Anyway, Paimon accepts this blessing — but only just, okay?
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Fine by me. In that case, the rite of witnesses is ended. But before you go, let me stress this again: be careful.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We know, Pacal. See ya! ... And seeya too, Uchu!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Roar!
<color=#ffffff>Uchu:</color> Roar...
<color=#ffffff>Pacal:</color> Good luck. See you all soon.
Obtain Talisman of Waxaklahun Ubah Kan

Manqu can also be found in 2 different locations before the beginning of this quest. He just needs to be spoken to in one of these locations.
